summary: A procedural harbor-city sandbox slice: ride and drive eight vehicles through live traffic and pedestrians, run four courier story missions and three activities, and outwit an evidence-based five-tier police Alert system.
notes: Verified by 65 headless simulation tests and a headless-Edge smoke run from a sub-path (no page errors; save/reload/continue works). Not verified: play with a real mouse (no pointer lock in headless), audio output (never heard), most of missions 2-4 and police chases on screen (simulation tests only, plus one mission-start and one police-arrival capture), Firefox/Safari, 1080p performance. All art and audio are procedural; no third-party assets. Bundle is 11.2 MB (3.2 MB gzip).
